LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.6: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: when ordering food in a How can we read short texts in a given context fluently? 31 restaurant (e.g. 我想要、请来......、 请问、有没有......、请问,有...... 吗?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. solve a simple crossword puzzle on food items found in a restaurant,

2. read out the corresponding Chinese vocabulary of the food items,

3. read sentences and underline commonly used quantifiers in the restaurant (e.g. 份、碗、杯、瓶、 双、个),

4. rearrange jumble up words related to cutlery used in a restaurant and read out the correct word for peer feedback (e.g. 菜单、酒杯、杯子、盘子、 碗、刀、叉子、勺子、筷子、服务 员、老板),

5. practise using commonly used action words

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. solve a simple crossword puzzle on food items found in a restaurant,
2. read out the corresponding Chinese vocabulary of the food items,
3. read sentences and underline commonly used quantifiers in the restaurant (e.g. 份、碗、杯、瓶、 双、个),
4. rearrange jumble up words related to cutlery used in a restaurant and read out the correct word for peer feedback (e.g. 菜单、酒杯、杯子、盘子、 碗、刀、叉子、勺子、筷子、服务 员、老板),
5. practise using commonly used action words

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: teamwork skills are developed as the learner participates actively in the role-play on ordering

food from a restaurant with peers.

Values:
Love: the learner portrays a caring attitude to their peers when they give honest and constructive feedback on their reading

skills.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective Communication: this is developed as the learner becomes aware of the essence of using appropriate and polite language

in communication.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Agriculture and Nutrition on the concept of the different foods and drinks.
